name: RGV Prospect Hunter
description: Find public local-business websites, validate each through the Web Scraper, score evidence-backed website opportunities, and generate personalized outreach drafts for WhatIf Web.
prompt: Run the WhatIf Web Prospect Hunter from this project. Ask for a target location (default Brownsville, TX) and industry, then discover public official business websites, validate each candidate through the local Web Scraper, keep claims evidence-backed and customer-facing, generate a concise outreach subject/body, and save the full packet under data/prospects with LATEST.md updated. Do not send email automatically. Do not imply that missing security headers mean a business is hacked or insecure. Public outreach must use only verified public business contact details, and the human reviews every message before sending.
